findings.claim: The site-content change has no acceptance criterion for factual accuracy or completed coverage; its exit gate checks only technical validity.
findings.evidence: docs-03 says to start from a "coverage matrix (topics × source × status) that separates shipped behavior from designed-not-built," but its gate is only "sanitizer + link check + mermaid check + production build all green." Nothing requires the matrix to be completed or the published claims to be checked against shipped behavior before deployment, despite the goal of a site "fully explaining the IPFS Obsidian plugin."
findings.suggested_fix: Add a docs-03 content gate requiring every required topic to map to a published page, every behavioral claim to have a checked source, and every designed-but-unbuilt feature to be explicitly labeled. Require resolution or explicit disclosure of all unchecked matrix entries before docs-04 deploys.
